checks.title: No real email addresses in source
checks.description: Source files must not contain real email addresses. Use @example.test for mock data.

checks.title: No real phone numbers in source
checks.description: Source files should not contain patterns that look like real phone numbers.

checks.title: No SSN patterns in source
checks.description: Source files must not contain social security number patterns.

checks.title: Manifest has a slug
checks.description: plannerxchange.app.json must define a non-empty slug.

checks.title: Manifest has a name
checks.description: plannerxchange.app.json must define a non-empty name.

checks.title: Manifest has an entryPoint
checks.description: plannerxchange.app.json must define an entryPoint.

checks.title: Manifest app folder is valid
checks.description: Optional appRoot and distRoot values must be repo-relative paths, and entryPoint must resolve inside the app folder.

checks.title: Manifest does not use inferred capability fields
checks.description: Detected capabilities are review output, not plannerxchange.app.json fields. Do not add capabilities, marketplace, portableData, demoMode, demoModeEnabled, supportsDemoMode, landingPage, landing_page, publicLandingPage, landingPageEnabled, or supportsLandingPage.

checks.title: Manifest has permissions
checks.description: plannerxchange.app.json should list required permission scopes.

checks.title: Canonical declarations match exact permissions
checks.description: Every canonical permission must have a matching category and read/write declaration, and every declaration scope must have a matching exact permission.

checks.title: Import entry points launch the PX wizard
checks.description: Ingress enums must be exact, every px_import_session declaration must match source and committed build calls, and import-facing UI may not end in app-authored informational copy.

checks.title: App-data requests use the PX record contract
checks.description: App-data operations must use list/create/get/update/delete semantics, server-issued record IDs, payload envelopes, matching permissions, and committed artifact evidence.

checks.title: Build output exists
checks.description: The configured distRoot directory must exist. Run `npm run build` before preflight.

checks.title: Publish manifest generated
checks.description: The configured distRoot must contain plannerxchange.publish.json after build.

checks.title: Build provenance generated
checks.description: The configured distRoot must contain plannerxchange.build-provenance.json after build.

checks.title: Build provenance matches app folder
checks.description: plannerxchange.build-provenance.json must record the same appRoot and distRoot declared by plannerxchange.app.json.

checks.title: Build assets use app-relative URLs
checks.description: Committed build output must not reference root-relative image/font assets such as /assets/logo.png, /logo.png, /images/..., /favicon.ico, or localhost asset URLs. Keep Vite base set to "./", import assets from source modules, rebuild, and commit the generated distRoot.

checks.title: Browser storage usage flagged
checks.description: Browser storage calls detected. Ensure localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB are mock-only or UI-preference-only and not used for production data persistence or PII.

checks.title: No appInstallationId query parameter
checks.description: Installed-app context must travel through shell-managed authenticatedFetch and x-plannerxchange-app-installation-id, not query strings.

checks.title: Manual auth header usage flagged
checks.description: Hosted apps should not read, store, or manually send PlannerXchange bearer tokens. Use ShellRuntimeContext.authenticatedFetch for PX API calls.

checks.title: No direct KMS or decrypt access
checks.description: Builder apps must not include direct KMS clients, decrypt commands, or restricted-PII decrypt helpers. PlannerXchange performs decryption only inside governed backend APIs.

checks.title: No builder-owned data backend for PX/client data
checks.description: Shell-published self-serve apps must not use builder-owned database clients, ORM clients, service-role keys, database URL env vars, or app-managed subscriber-data backends for PX/client/subscriber data.

checks.title: No app-owned backend API routes
checks.description: Shell-published apps are static frontend plugins. Do not call standalone app backend routes such as /api/questions, /api/results, /questions, or /results.

checks.title: No app-owned auth, signup, or checkout routes
checks.description: Public landing-page CTAs for sign in, sign up, install, checkout, billing, reviews, follows, and demo must hand off to PlannerXchange-owned routes instead of app-owned routes.

checks.title: External form, calendar, or checkout provider flagged
checks.description: Public landing pages must not post Book demo, Contact us, Join waitlist, checkout, or billing flows to builder-owned form, calendar, CRM, webhook, or payment providers unless PlannerXchange later approves a specific contract.

checks.title: No app-owned backend URL env vars
checks.description: Do not use VITE_API_URL, VITE_BACKEND_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, or similar frontend env vars for shell-published runtime behavior.

checks.title: Router uses PlannerXchange runtime path context
checks.description: Browser routers must use context.appBasename, and memory/hash routers must initialize from context.initialPath so PX shell deep links do not render an app-owned 404.

checks.title: No stale containerElement runtime contract
checks.description: PlannerXchange calls mount(context); the current context does not provide containerElement. Resolve #root or #app inside mount(context).

checks.title: CSV/file ingress must be declared
checks.description: File inputs, FileReader, FormData uploads, Papa Parse, csv/xlsx packages, and drag/drop uploads require dataIngressDeclarations and review of the target storage lane.

checks.title: No shell-only import or integration routes
checks.description: Builder apps must not call /imports/*, /integrations/*, Core Data mapping/validation/execute routes, or shell-owned provider routes directly.

checks.title: No completed import-session result handling
checks.description: openDataImportSession is launch-only and returns { mode: "canonical_store", status: "launched" }. Do not wait for completed_with_errors, importJobId, canonicalRefs, or mappingSummary.

checks.title: No external CSV/file upload hosts
checks.description: Apps that handle PX/client CSV or file uploads must use PlannerXchange-controlled ingress or enterprise exception review, not vendor upload endpoints.

checks.title: No frontend external provider API keys
checks.description: Do not expose Tavily, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar provider API keys in browser code. Shell-published apps run in users' browsers.

checks.title: External AI/search SDK usage flagged
checks.description: External AI or search-provider usage is a publish-review trigger. Day 1 external provider egress of PX/client data is not allowed without an enterprise exception.

checks.title: No hardcoded PX API URLs
checks.description: Use ctx.apiBaseUrl from the shell runtime context instead of hardcoding API URLs. This ensures apps work correctly across dev/staging/prod environments.
